title: Spatial Contract v1 -- Feedback Result
$comment: New in Stage D1 -- no prior draft schema covered this record type. This is the fifth non-negotiable record type (Phase D prompt: 'feedback must cite locked criterion decisions'). A feedback_result must cite the criterion_decision_result IDs it is explaining and, when the response was not released for automated scoring, must cite the confidence_and_abstention_result that explains why. Citation-integrity tests fail closed if any cited ID does not resolve.

release_status.description: Must be consistent with the cited confidence_and_abstention_result.decision -- RELEASED_TO_LEARNER requires that record's decision to be RELEASE_AUTOMATED; the other two require ABSTAIN_*/RETAKE_REQUIRED. Enforced by validate_phase_d_contracts.py's citation-integrity check, not just documented here.

cited_criterion_decision_ids.description: criterion_decision_result IDs this feedback explains. May be empty only when release_status is a SUPPRESSED_* value and no per-criterion detail is being shown yet.

cited_confidence_and_abstention_result_i.description: Required (non-null) when release_status is a SUPPRESSED_* value, so learners/reviewers see a calibrated reason rather than an unexplained withholding. May be null only when release_status is RELEASED_TO_LEARNER and every cited criterion decision already carries sufficient context on its own (item-author judgment call, not the common case).

per_criterion_feedback.description: Each entry's criterion_decision_id must also appear in cited_criterion_decision_ids.
